decks.notes: The main focus of this Orzhov Aggro deck is to utilize low-cost creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage efficiently. By combining aggressive creatures like Goldmeadow Nomad and Amalia Benavides Aguirre with low-cost support cards like Lunar Convocation and Raise the Past, the deck aims to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent early on. Additionally, cards like Resolute Reinforcements and Haliya, Guided by Light provide additional support and ways to maintain tempo in the game. With a balanced mana base and strong synergies, this deck aims to secure victory through relentless aggression and efficient card advantage.

With a mix of creatures with various abilities and support spells, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and secure victory before they can react effectively.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures and powerful planeswalkers to apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of versatile removal spells like Burst Lightning and Erode helps to maintain board control while pushing for a fast and aggressive playstyle. By utilizing a mix of powerful creatures and planeswalkers, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield and secure victory through aggressive tactics.
